REGISTER SOONFri 6 Nov 2026, 11:00am

Additional Members Sale Registration All Red Members with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 4 or more

Read more

Supporters with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 4 or more wishing to purchase tickets during the additional members sale taking place on Monday 16 November must register their interest.

Registration for the Additional Members Sale will be open online from 11am on Friday 6 November until 10am on Saturday 7 November ONLY.

Please note: This is not a ballot, tickets will be available to purchase during the Additional Members Sale on a first come first served basis and no guarantee can be given to all who apply.

All Red Members (Full, Light, & Junior) can register for one ticket per qualifying supporter up to a maximum of FOUR tickets per transaction.

Supporters with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 3 can register their interest to purchase tickets.

ON SALE SOONMon 16 Nov 2026, 11:00am

Additional Members Sale All Red Members with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 4 or more who registered

Read more

TICKET SALE

From 11am Monday 16 November

Eligible supporters will be sent a unique link on Friday 13 November, which will allow them to access the ticketing site when the ticket sale opens.

ELIGIBILITY

Only All Red Members (Full, Light or Junior) with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 4 or more AND have registered will be eligible for this sale.

Supporters can purchase one ticket per qualifying supporter up to a maximum of FOUR tickets per booking.

Tickets for this sale are subject to availability.

Tickets purchased during this sale cannot be forwarded to other supporters or listed for resale on the Ticket Exchange

Young Adult Area Ballot All Red Members Aged Between 17-24yrs

Read more

Registration: Opens 10am Friday 6 November until 9am Saturday 7 November.

Ballot: Takes place Wednesday 11 November. Please note you will only receive a confirmation email if your application is successful.

For full details click here.

All Red members aged 17-24yrs must have purchased an All Red membership (Full or Light) by midnight Thursday 5 November to be eligible to register for the ballot.

Supporters can register for one ticket per qualifying supporter up to a maximum of FOUR tickets per transaction.

IMPORTANT

Tickets allocated in the Young Adult area cannot be forwarded to another supporter, however, they can be listed on the Ticket Exchange for other Young Adult All Red members to purchase.
